hero.tagline: I build robust backend systems and modern web applications, with a focus on Python, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a Full-Stack Developer currently at Accenture, where I build web applications with FastAPI and Vue.js while managing DevOps pipelines on Azure. With 4+ years of experience, I specialize in Python ecosystems — Django, DRF, Flask, and FastAPI.
about.p2: Previously, I coordinated a team at TinGo, delivering a ticketing platform from backend to cloud infrastructure. I also built microservices and internal tools at UFRN's IT department, and developed a marketplace platform at Fiscallize.
about.p3: I'm pursuing a Bachelor's in Information Technology at UFRN (graduating Dec 2026). I'm passionate about clean architecture, scalable systems, and bridging the gap between development and operations.
